campus anchor cannot create an available kiosk

archetypes.name: Cultural-venue cafe

nearby residents cannot be added to internal demand

archetypes.name: Destination flagship

property scale cannot add customer demand

tourism guide labels cannot create a numeric score

archetypes.name: Destination roastery flagship

archetypes.required_gate: #26 destination contract plus production, loading, zoning and program feasibility
prohibited_substitutions: production capacity cannot add customer demand
roastery program cannot create visitor counts

archetypes.name: Drive-through coffee
archetypes.mission: vehicle origins and compatible pass-by routes

prohibited_substitutions: walkability or population density cannot replace vehicle flow
road proximity cannot replace legal access

archetypes.name: Hospital-captive kiosk
archetypes.mission: staff, patient-family and visitor flow on governed accessible internal connections
archetypes.required_gate: named facility/building/access zone and live food-service opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: nearby population cannot replace facility flow
healthcare jobs cannot create patient or visitor counts

archetypes.name: Hotel-lobby cafe
archetypes.mission: hotel guests, workers, meetings and authorized visitors exposed to the same lobby or governed internal circulation

prohibited_substitutions: hotel count or reviews cannot replace occupied rooms
nearby visitors cannot be added without lobby access

archetypes.name: Industrial / logistics district counter
archetypes.mission: shift workers, drivers and industrial employees

blue-collar count cannot replace shift or driver flow

archetypes.name: Mall / food-court kiosk

external population cannot be added to internal circulation

archetypes.name: Medical-district street counter

staff-only entrances cannot create public demand

archetypes.name: Permitted mobile street cart

strong demand cannot create a legal vending right

takeaway demand cannot be increased merely because the unit is larger

archetypes.name: Neighborhood main-street takeaway
archetypes.mission: resident and routine origins
archetypes.required_gate: public street-facing storefront with governed pedestrian-network catchment
prohibited_substitutions: tourist places cannot replace resident routine
night-light cannot replace night demand

archetypes.name: Office-district coffeehouse
archetypes.mission: weekday office-worker workplace blocks
archetypes.required_gate: public seated storefront routed to qualified workplaces with suitable unit/program
prohibited_substitutions: office jobs cannot establish meetings, dwell or occupancy
street demand cannot be counted again as lobby demand

archetypes.name: Office-district street express
archetypes.mission: weekday worker buildings and trip ends
archetypes.required_gate: independent street storefront routed to qualified workplace access proxies within the 5/8-minute contract
prohibited_substitutions: resident population cannot replace worker demand
jobs cannot be labelled observed attendance

archetypes.name: Office-lobby counter
archetypes.mission: occupants, registered visitors and explicitly connected concourse users
archetypes.required_gate: named office building, controlled lobby/concourse zone and live landlord unit
prohibited_substitutions: external resident or street population cannot be added as lobby demand
jobs cannot replace occupancy or access

archetypes.name: Private members-club cafe
archetypes.mission: Primary evidence components: CAPTIVE_HOST
archetypes.required_gate: named club, membership/access regime, internal zone and operator opportunity
prohibited_substitutions: nearby affluence cannot create club members
club presence cannot create an operating right

archetypes.name: Public-space kiosk
archetypes.mission: accessible park or plaza paths, entrances and hosted activity

prohibited_substitutions: park interior supply cannot replace accessible entrance demand
attractive public space cannot create availability

archetypes.name: Regional terminal / ferry concourse

scheduled service cannot replace traversals

archetypes.name: Reservation coffee / tea salon

planned occasion cannot be inferred from generic footfall

archetypes.name: Residential amenity cafe

residential units cannot create amenity usage

archetypes.name: Retail shop-in-shop

prohibited_substitutions: store count or reviews cannot replace store trips
nearby shoppers cannot be added without entering the host

archetypes.name: Scheduled-rail-adjacent street express

prohibited_substitutions: scheduled departures cannot be labelled passenger population
station centroid cannot replace entrance routing

archetypes.name: Shopping-center inline cafe

archetypes.name: In-station subway kiosk

station service cannot replace internal passenger traversals

archetypes.name: Visitor-attraction cafe

prohibited_substitutions: attraction presence/reviews cannot replace admissions
nearby tourists cannot be added without entering the attraction

job count cannot replace authorized occupancy or shift attendance
